title: The Drop of the DMZ
author: Lior Dunmore
blurb: Kestrel Okafor, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
